title: Implementation Pulse Tracker — Inference Rollouts (Pilot → Scale)
body:
Context:
This is a lightweight, sprint-paced tracker meant to be maintained during pilot → scale rollouts for inference customers. Goal is to keep a single-source pulse on milestones, owners, main blockers, mitigations, and renewal-trigger signals (usage and SLA progress). Use this for weekly CS+SRE touchpoints and handoffs to Solutions/Platform during Dedicated or Private migrations.

How to use:
- Owner updates row each Wednesday before the CS sync.
- Highlight any new blocker in Slack #cs-inference-rollouts with a short summary and link to the row id (see linked_artifacts).
- Add Jira tickets to linked_artifacts as they are created; keep the primary Jira ID in the row.

High-level rollout phases (this doc focuses on the transition from Pilot → Scale):
1) Pilot (10–50 seats / dev-stage): validate correctness, latency targets, prompt set quality.
2) Expand (scale tests, throughput, autoscaling policy): 50–500 seats, integration with caching and batching.
3) GA (SLA, billing, renewal trigger monitoring): customer on contract for production capacity.

Pulse table (rows = milestone clusters). Each row: milestone | ETA | owner | status | blockers (short) | mitigation / next action | key metric(s) | jira

Row 1 — Pilot success criteria sign-off:
- Milestone: Signed off pilot demo + baseline perf report
- ETA: 2025-09-12
- Owner: Diego Marquez
- Status: complete
- Blockers: none (see notes)
- Mitigation / Next action: Post-mortem notes in Confluence-8173; schedule expand kickoff
- Key metrics: p95 latency <= 220ms (token stream), average cost per 1k tokens = $0.19
- Jira: JIRA-CS-4321

Row 2 — Integration with customer auth + VPC peering:
- Milestone: VPC peering + IAM mapping in staging
- ETA: 2025-09-22
- Owner: Emily Chen
- Status: in_progress
- Blockers: routing ACL misconfig reported by customer network team
- Mitigation / Next action: SRE to apply temporary route and test; escalate to infra by 2025-09-10 if BGP session not established
- Key metrics: successful end-to-end sample requests (10/10) from customer subnet, no TLS handshake failures
- Jira: JIRA-NET-2250

Row 3 — Autoscaling policy validation (throughput tests):
- Milestone: Policy tuned for 99th pct request burst; documented config for Dedicated sizes
- ETA: 2025-09-30
- Owner: Noah Singh
- Status: at_risk
- Blockers: observed tail latency spikes during 2x burst scenario in stress tests
- Mitigation / Next action: Run kernel-level profiling; enable continuous batching flag on a canary pool; SRE to add tracing hook by 2025-09-14
- Key metrics: 99th pct latency <= 400ms during bursts; no more than 5% dropped requests
- Jira: JIRA-RUNTIME-998

Row 4 — KV cache warmup and prompt caching rules:
- Milestone: Cache hit ratio >= 40% for chat sessions after warmup window
- ETA: 2025-10-07
- Owner: Riley Thompson
- Status: in_progress
- Blockers: customer usage pattern has many unique prefixes; cache effectiveness low in pilot
- Mitigation / Next action: Implement prefix grouping heuristic and TTL adjustments; product to provide list of canonical prompts to seed cache
- Key metrics: cache hit ratio, tokens saved, cost delta
- Jira: GH-PR-142 (optimizations)

Row 5 — SLAs and renewal readiness:
- Milestone: SLA template approved + renewal KPI dashboard ready
- ETA: 2025-10-20
- Owner: Asha Patel
- Status: in_progress
- Blockers: finance billing mapping for token tiers unresolved; renewal team needs a clear usage threshold to trigger uplift conversations
- Mitigation / Next action: Finance and product to finalize tier mapping by 2025-09-25; CS to draft renewal playbook triggers (tied to sustained 30-day usage and error/SLO compliance)
- Key metrics: 30-day avg tokens >= 1.2M, error rate < 0.5%, p95 latency within contracted SLO
- Jira: SALES-RENEW-61

Open blockers (detailed):
- Network peering instability (Emily): intermittent BGP resets seen; timeline 48–72h for root cause. Temporary workaround: use customer edge proxy for pilot traffic. Owner: Emily Chen. Escalation: infra@redwood.com if not resolved in 72h.
- Burst latency (Noah): profiling needed to determine if kernel scheduling or model kernel selection causes tail spike. Action: profiling task + observability dashboards. Owner: Noah Singh. Escalation: eng-serving-runtime leads.
- Billing mapping (Asha): need mapping from token units to customer's internal billing SKU. Action: engage finance; document mapping in Confluence. Owner: Asha Patel.

Renewal-trigger playbook (short form):
- Signal set (primary): 30-day sustained usage > 1M tokens, < 2% rolling error rate, p95 latency within SLA for two consecutive weeks.
- Secondary signals: adoption of dedicated capacity, custom integrations (VPC/on-prem requests), and usage smoothing (low burst failure rate).
- Actions on trigger: start renewal sequence (AE + CS + Solutions) with 6 week cadence: 1) initial notification and HLD of Dedicated options, 2) usage forecast + cost runbook, 3) contract terms + SLAs discussion.

Risk register (quick heat map):
- High: Autoscaling tail latency spikes — affects GA timeline (Noah)
- Medium: Billing SKU mapping — blocks renewal conversations (Asha)
- Medium: VPC peering reliability — impacts production traffic path (Emily)
- Low: Cache seeding — affects cost but not functional correctness (Riley)

Meeting cadence / ownership summary:
- CS weekly sync (Wednesdays): status review against this doc; owners update rows. Attendees: CS, SRE, Solutions lead.
- Engineering deep-dive (bi-weekly): Noah + runtime + infra to review traces and profiling.
- Renewal health review (monthly): CS + Finance + Sales to review triggers and draft renewals.

Notes to self / open questions:
- Do we want automated Slack alerts when a row flips to at_risk or blocked? (propose yes; notify #cs-escalations)
- Can Product commit to providing canonical prompt set for cache seeding by 2025-09-16?
- Is there a simple mapping table from tokens -> customer SKU available from Finance? If not, escalate.

Next immediate actions (this week):
1) Emily to post BGP logs to the thread and request infra on-call help (due 2025-09-05).
2) Noah to onboard kernel tracer to the canary pool (due 2025-09-07).
3) Asha to schedule renewal trigger alignment meeting with Finance (due 2025-09-08).

Changelog (minor):
- 2025-09-02: Document created; pilot sign-off row added (Diego).
- 2025-09-09: Autoscaling marked at_risk after stress run; additional tracing requested (Noah).
- 2025-10-06: Billing mapping issue escalated; renewal playbook draft linked.

Quick contacts:
- CS lead: Asha Patel — asha@redwood.ai
- SRE on-call: pagerduty link (see linked_artifacts)
- Escalations: infra@redwood.com, solutions@redwood.com

(End of tracker)
